Create the configuration file and optionally set the connection string

USAGE:
    efg initialize [OPTIONS]

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help                                     Prints help information      
    -p, --provider <PROVIDER>                      Database provider to reverse 
                                                   engineer                     
    -c, --connection-string <CONNECTION_STRING>    Database connection string to
                                                   reverse engineer             
        --id <USER_SECRETS_ID>                     The user secret ID to use    
        --name <CONNECTION_NAME>                   The user secret configuration
                                                   name                         
    -d, --directory <DIRECTORY>                    The root working directory   
    -f, --file <FILE>                              The options file name
